reasons.correctness: Port, adapter, PLN=1, case-insensitive match, HALF_UP scale 2 and error key all work; 5/5 hidden tests pass. But the application.yml insertion split `cors:`, so `max-age: 86400` now binds as `currency.max-age`, silently dropping the CORS setting.
reasons.convention_fit: The port sits in `currency/port` and the adapter in `currency/adapter`. The service depends on the port, uses constructor injection, and throws `BusinessRuleTranslatableException` with keys in both message files. The yml edit changes untouched `cors` config, breaking the change-only-what-is-needed rule.
reasons.design_fit: Cohesive layout and the service depends only on the port type. The adapter scans the rates map with `equalsIgnoreCase` on every call instead of normalising keys once. The misplaced yml block corrupts an unrelated config section.
reasons.test_quality: `CurrencyConversionServiceUnitTest` covers the rate, HALF_UP rounding and the missing-rate key with its args. `FixedExchangeRateAdapterUnitTest` covers PLN, case-insensitivity and unknown codes but lacks `@ExtendWith(MockitoExtension.class)`. There is no null-ISO test.
reasons.graph_use: Graph queries for `*Port.java`, currency entities and the registry package came before any edit and led to the CompanyRegistryPort/adapter example. Later navigation (config binding, yml, messages) relied on grep and reads.
